nodes.name: Workflow overview and setup

parameters.content:
## Review match results and manage corrected sports videos with TheSportsDB

### How it works
For sports editors managing a result from first review through corrections. Fetch a queued event directly from TheSportsDB and require approval of its exact fact snapshot. Recheck facts on each run; changed facts invalidate old approval. Compare with the latest completed video, produce an approved original or correction edition, and retain the prior result and video in a correction pack. No LLM or automatic social posting is used. Accepted jobs resume before new source requests; completed keys are not rendered again.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Configure **Zvid API** using [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`; select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect Google Sheets. Select **Match Editorial Queue** for the input nodes and **Sports Recaps** for recovery. Log headers: RenderKey, Status, JobId, CreditsQuoted, PlanJson, VideoUrl, CompletedAt.
4. Input headers: EventId, Enabled, Approval, ApprovedSnapshot, CurrentSnapshot, ReviewStatus, LastCheckedAt, PriorVideoUrl, ChangeSummary. Set Enabled=yes. Configure sportsDbKey and leagueId. Review CurrentSnapshot before copying it to ApprovedSnapshot and setting Approval=approved.
5. **dryRun=false spends credits** after eligibility. true returns JSON, quote and review files without writes or rendering. Set maxCreditsPerVideo.
6. Run one execution at a time. Review **Watch video → Binary → data → View** before sharing. Read the [companion guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/sports-recap-video.md) for field rules and migration.

### Customization
Enable additional events in the same queue. Corrections require new approval; never delete previous editions.

nodes.name: 1. Choose source rules and schedule

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose source rules and schedule

Complete the overview setup and source contract. Run one execution at a time. Use the manual trigger before enabling the schedule.

nodes.name: 2. Recover accepted work before source checks

parameters.content:
## 2. Recover accepted work before source checks

Resume saved paid jobs even if the upstream source is unavailable. A preview never resumes a paid job.

nodes.name: 3. Choose one editorial case

parameters.content:
## 3. Choose one editorial case

Process the least recently checked Enabled=yes EventId. Approval is tied to the complete fact snapshot and edition. The workflow never grants approval.

nodes.name: 4. Check final results against the rendered history

parameters.content:
## 4. Check final results against the rendered history

Fetch the exact requested event. Compare its final facts with the previous completed edition. Changed facts require a new approval snapshot; uncertain render history blocks a replacement.

nodes.name: 5. Save review facts and protect human approval

parameters.content:
## 5. Save review facts and protect human approval

Update CurrentSnapshot and review status only. Review the facts, then set Approval=approved and copy CurrentSnapshot into ApprovedSnapshot. Dry runs skip these writes. Corrections retain the previous video.

nodes.name: 6. Continue only when the plan is eligible

parameters.content:
## 6. Continue only when the plan is eligible

Empty input, completed work, missing approval and blocked history return an explicit report. They spend no render credits.

nodes.name: 7. Recover accepted work before a new render

parameters.content:
## 7. Recover accepted work before a new render

Saved jobs follow the upper route using their original review context. New work continues through optional media and the domain design.

nodes.name: 8. Check optional background music

parameters.content:
## 8. Check optional background music

A failed or oversized music file is skipped. Empty musicUrl continues without an external request. This check preserves the selected source plan.

nodes.name: 9. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

parameters.content:
## 9. Build and validate the design and credit ceiling

dryRun=true returns the source plan, design JSON and quote. It performs no log writes, editor draft creation, render, or delivery.

nodes.name: 10. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

parameters.content:
## 10. Reserve the key and preserve the accepted job

Save the key and accepted job ID. Retry explicit capacity rejections up to three attempts, respecting the server delay and a 30-second minimum. Uncertain submissions require inspection. Sheets is not an atomic lock.

nodes.name: 11. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

parameters.content:
## 11. Wait for the accepted render and record its result

Poll the saved job within the deadline. Keep failed, timed-out and uncertain job IDs for inspection. Completed keys are skipped on later runs.

nodes.name: 12. Review the video and source-specific handoff

parameters.content:
## 12. Review the video and source-specific handoff

Completed renders reach Watch video → Binary → data → View. A failed render stops with its actual reason after saving the tracking row. Download the review CSV and check source facts before sharing.
